body:
## What this listing is

This is Localrent's car hire page for Italy. Localrent lists cars from local rental companies, so the choice depends on who is active in the country. The page shows not stated in the text we read cars when we searched, with a rating of 4.8 out of 5 from 4,509 reviews, which is Localrent's figure for the whole service.

## What the filters showed

The counts change with your dates and pick-up point, so run your own search to see what is available.

## A sample price

The lowest-priced car we saw was a Fiat Panda, 17.85$ per day or 249.84$ for 14 days, a new car with free cancellation, unlimited mileage, instant booking and no credit card needed. These prices are for the dates we searched and for one car model, so they are a guide, not a quote.

## What else the page says

The page describes comparing deals from local rental companies and picking the one that suits the trip and budget; it names Rome, Milan and Naples among the cities you could reach. Each car card also shows its cover: minimum and basic cover are free of charge on many listings, while full cover is available at an extra daily charge on some and unavailable on others.

## What to check

Look at the mileage limit, because some cars carry a daily cap and others state unlimited mileage. Check the deposit and the cancellation terms on the specific car, since they differ from one local company to another. Localrent shows photos for only some cars, so read the description before you book.

## When it fits

It suits a road trip between Italian cities where you want a simple deal and no card hold. If you need a pick-up outside the places Localrent lists, compare it with the other providers on this site's car rental page.
